test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has more than one seat in the Lok Sabha?
solution: The correct answer is **Meghalaya**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** - **Nagaland**, **Sikkim**, and **Mizoram** each have only one seat in the Lok Sabha. - **Meghalaya** has two seats in the Lok Sabha: **Shillong** and **Tura**. - The **Lok Sabha** is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament. - **Meghalaya** is represented by two Members of Parliament due to its population and geographical considerations.
